wiringInterpretation.rationale: Plan_final 07-003 pins the complete 20-kind MenuAction discriminant vocabulary (New Game/Options/Sound/Read This/Save/Load/End Game/Quit and their slider/toggle/text-entry sub-actions) and wires the producer (handleMenuKey) + MENU_ACTION_NONE + openMessage + the MenuAction type into a single src/vanilla re-export facade for the runtime-effects dispatcher. The focused test cross-checks the manifest against the actual union declared in the read-only src/ui/menus.ts so a dropped/renamed kind fails the gate. Pure barrel + frozen ASCIIbetically-sorted manifest, no source modification. Unblocked by the e365561 prereq-cycle fix chain.
